summary.text: Marilyn Connolly is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 40, serving since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Marilyn Connolly has served on the Rural Health Care Board, as a Johnson County Commissioner, on the Search and Rescue Council and on the Buffalo Senior Center Board.
Connolly assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 6, 2025, succeeding Barry Crago.
For 2025-2026, Connolly serves on the House Travel, Recreation, Wildlife and Cultural Resources Committee.
